glossary.definition: A named purpose for an agent action, with example phrases (exemplars), a similarity floor, and twin intents it must be told apart from. Shapes from the Privilege console swagger (imodelAIIntent*); the lab's resolution engine over them is lab-invented.
Two intents declared as confusable (Spec.Twins on both). The lab denies an action that lands over both floors within 0.05 of each other rather than guessing.
Spec.Floor: the minimum encoder similarity for an action to match an intent. Each intent carries its own.
Encoder.FailClosed on: when no intent matches, deny. Off (fail-open): allow with "no intent matched" — shown in the lab as a bad default for a payments app.

cards.label: Scenario 1: A matched acting intent allows
cards.description: An action whose text lands over the intent's Floor on an Acts=true intent is allowed, bound to that intent.

cards.label: Scenario 2: A read-only intent refuses a write-shaped action
cards.description: check-balance is Acts=false. The lab reads that as "describes, does not authorize": an action matched only by it is denied as read-only.

cards.label: Scenario 3: Twin intents within a hair are ambiguous
cards.description: transfer-funds and pay-beneficiary are declared twins. An action that lands over both floors with less than 0.05 between them is refused rather than guessed — money must not move on a coin flip.

cards.label: Scenario 4: Below the floor nothing matches
cards.description: An action that does not resemble any exemplar scores under every Floor. Fail-closed (the default) denies; fail-open would allow with "no intent matched".

cards.label: Scenario 5: An app that selects no intents has no intent resolution
cards.description: Empty IntentIDs means NO intents can match — the lab reads it as "this app has no intent policy", so fail-closed denies everything. There is no "empty means all".

cards.label: Scenario 6: Fail-open lets unmatched text through
cards.description: With Encoder.FailClosed=false, an action under every floor is allowed with "no intent matched" — the lab shows why fail-open on a payments app is a bad default.
